segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Hey, can you look at the Northlake account with me for a sec? I'm cleaning up the forecast and the CRM is, uh, not super helpful.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Yeah, I have it open. Looks like 84 seats today, finance team added 12 back in March, and they're using the reporting add-on.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Right. Their agreement ends next Friday, June 28, and I don't see any selling-side note that anyone has talked to them about continuing after that.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Okay. The billing tool shows the last invoice was $18,450 for the quarter, paid on time May 3. No open tickets besides that SSO question.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Good. I was thinking keep the seat count flat at 84 for the quote, one-year term, same package. Pricing sheet has them at $73 per seat monthly if we hold the discount.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Deal desk will ask why the discount is staying at 9 percent. Just put usage is steady and they're not expanding departments yet.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Yep. And implementation notes say their HRIS sync go-live was April 15, so no services line needed unless they want admin training.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: I'll update the CRM close date to June 27 and attach the draft order form. Can you send me the tax entity? I see Northlake Foods LLC and Northlake Shared Services.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Use Shared Services. Their AP alias bounced the LLC invoice last time, so let's not repeat that.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Got it. I'll have the draft ready in 20, and you can sanity check the totals before it goes out.
